question: Manika Batra is famous as an Indian _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __table tennis player.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manika Batra: She is a top-ranked Indian table tennis player and ranked 63rd in the world.
 
• She specializes in playing long pimples on her backhand.
 
• She was born on June 15, 1995, at New Delhi.
 
• She was two times Gold medal winner in the commonwealth games 2018.
 
• She has represented India in the South Asian games 2016 and won 3 Gold medals. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award:__ It is the highest sporting award of the Republic of India.

 __
 
• It was named after former prime minister Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• It was given by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports for the spectacular and most outstanding performance in the field of sports by a sportsperson over a period of four years.
 
• The award comprises of Medallion and a Cash prize of 25 lakh rupees.
 
• Award was instituted in 1991-92.
 
• First awardee: Viswanath Anand.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was renamed as the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in August 2021: 
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** is India's highest sporting honor and is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. The award is named after the legendary Indian field hockey player Major Dhyan Chand (1905–79).
